name: CreateImportBatch
description: Step 1 of ReadBankFile. Creates the ImportBatches row of an uploaded bank file (kind קובץ בנק, extractionStatus בקריאה, readerAgent BankFileReader, workDay = Israel upload date with Fri/Sat counted to Thursday, checkStatus טרם התחילו). The same file (same name and size on the same work day) returns the existing batch with shouldRead=false unless it failed. With importBatchId it re-opens a failed/stuck batch for another read. Writes only ImportBatches.

uploadedBy.description: Display name of the person uploading

importBatchId.description: Retry: re-read this existing batch (only if it is נכשל or stuck in בקריאה)

asOfDate.description: Clock for tests: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in Asia/Jerusalem
